To
All Regional PF Commissioners,
In-charge of Regional / Sub Regional Offices

Subject : Levy of Penal Damages under Section 14B and interest
under Section 7Q of EPF & MP Act, 1952.

Dear Sir,

A report function for Levy of Penal Damages and for informing
the amount of Payable Interest against an establishment was provided in
the new application software and same was circulated to ail field offices
vide circular No. C-III/4(25)2006/DL/NZ/15253 dated 25.11.2013. All
Regional PF Commissioners, In-charge of Regional / Sub Regional Offices
were directed to make use of the above facility and to ensure that the
damages and interest in all applicable cases upto 31.12.2013 were levied
by 31.03.2014. Further instructions were also issued vide subsequent
reminder via e-mail dated 11.03.2014.

2. All officers In-charge of Field offices are expected to have
completed the above task and issued notices for levy of damages under
Section 14B and interest under Section 7Q of the Act. In some of the
cases proceedings must have been completed, damages and interest
levied and recovered by the concerned offices.

3. The feedback received from field offices was analyzed in Head
Office and it was found that the information sent by field offices was not
complete and / or not in the prescribed proforma. Since a huge amount
is involved in this exercise and the process of levy and recovery of
damages and interest being a continuous process it is decided that the
progress in this regard will be monitored on monthly basis till damages
and interest are recovered in all cases. The information regarding
issue of notices, damages and interest levied and amount
recovered is therefore, to be reported by field offices to the Head
Office every month by 5'" day of the next month in the prescribed
proforma (enclosed). The first such report for the month of
August, 2014 may be sent by all field offices to this office via e-
mail at rc.compliance@epfindia.gov.in by 5‘ Sept, 2014 so that the

information may be compiled for further directions in the matter. The
information must be sent strictly in the proforma enclosed herewith in
excel format only filling up all the columns of the proforma.

4. Kindly note that every Regional Office / Sub Regional! Office is
required to send the information directly to Head Office. The information
is not to be compiled at Regional Office / Zonal Office level.

Yours faithfully,
